![](images/00/0030e466a772b1ccd61140453c5e0e50ff365a0bf42034422bce9e1691983c43.png)

Find $\frac{dy}{dx}$ for the right-opening parabola shown above.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The right-opening parabola has vertex $(0,0)$ and passes through $(1,2)$. Its equation is $y^2=4x$. Differentiate to obtain $2yy'=4$, so $$\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac2y$$ for $y\ne0$.
